card.name: Words setting up a reason or exception
card.fires_on: Short words right after 'the only', 'part of the' or 'dosage may', where a reason, condition or change is about to be stated. Also fires on a few sentence ends and spaces in dosing text.

modes.label: Reason or cause setups
modes.description: The word 'way', 'reason' or 'danger' after 'the only' or 'the', leading into an explanation.
modes.example: The only<< way>> that they will appear on his balance sheet

modes.label: Dose adjustment or resumption wording
modes.description: Helper words like 'may' or 'be' in lines about adjusting, modifying or resuming treatment.
modes.example: Dosage may<< be>> adjusted by a healthcare provider based on individual

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning stop, terminate, pause or exception, in several languages.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about to give a reason, a condition or a reason to stop or change something.
